mcq.s:
The Atmanirbhar Bharat campaign announced by the Government helps in:
1. Enhancing India's manufacturing capabilities and exports across industries.
2. Incentivising foreign investment for domestic production.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
mcq.x: Atmanirbhar Bharat (2020) aims to raise domestic manufacturing and make India an export and supply-chain hub; it is not against FDI and liberalises FDI to encourage production within India.

mcq.s: Which one of the following is NOT true about the AYUSHMAN SAHAKAR scheme?
o: It was launched by the Union Finance Ministry
It assists cooperatives in creating healthcare infrastructure
It covers establishment, modernisation, expansion, repair and renovation of hospital, healthcare and education infrastructure
It was formulated by the National Cooperative Development Corporation (NCDC)
mcq.x: AYUSHMAN SAHAKAR was launched in October 2020 by the Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare (now under the Ministry of Cooperation) and was formulated by NCDC; it was not a Finance Ministry scheme.

mcq.s: Which of the following statements is/are NOT correct about the U-WIN portal of the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare?
o: It facilitates the creation of Ayushman Bharat Health Accounts (ABHA)
The portal is accessible in 11 regional languages
mcq.x: U-WIN digitises all Universal Immunisation Programme vaccinations; it gives QR-based e-certificates, helps create ABHA IDs and is available in 11 regional languages, so all three statements are correct.
